title: Pop out v2
brief: Pop out, remade under the founder's one-thread motion philosophy (prompt.motion-brief.one-thread-showreel.v1) so it can be compared with v1. Same message for people who have never heard of Curate: your closet is already in your photos. One continuous transformation, no cuts and no fades: her pieces outline and pop out of her real photos; the last outline becomes the scan's grid; the words collapse into the line that draws the phone; her photo's tiles flip into the real scan (Zee's magnifier); the scan's tiles fold into the real Wardrobe's tiles; her pieces rise out of the Wardrobe as the camera orbits forward; the denim jacket collapses into Curate's star; the star becomes the end card and opens back into the first frame (a loop). Geist only; black, white and three colours from her wardrobe (denim, camel, sage); one camera that only dollies or orbits forward; something changes on every beat of Cat Walk (130 BPM, beat-mapped); designed sound made in code on top of the music.
hook: 0–2 s: her photo; on the drop a denim outline draws round her jacket and it pops out; on each beat the next photo floods out of the next piece's own shape (camel coat, sage set).
disclosures: Emma is an AI-generated persona and her photos are AI-generated: turn on the platform AI label (TikTok "AI-generated content", Meta "AI info", YouTube "altered or synthetic content").

The app footage is real (Curate 1.5.0, build 262, Emma's account): the scan and the Wardrobe, time-remapped so the app's own moves land on the beat (sped up about 1.2x in places, the still stretches between them skipped).
Music: Mixkit Stock Music Free License (Cat Walk, Arulo): online and social ads are fine; no TV/radio, never register it with Content ID. The designed sound on top is Curate's own, generated in code.
notes: 9x16 15 s only: the brief was written for this one format. A test of the one-thread rules; nothing here is a house rule until the founder says so.
